subject: Quantis pilot: action canvas request + initial evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantis.ai>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Quantis pilot: initial info and MAP request

Hi Hiro (and Jasmine),

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited to explore a short pilot. I attached a short requirements spreadsheet (Quantis-Requirements.xlsx) that summarizes our initial goals and data constraints.

Would you be able to share a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template you typically use for week0 -> week8 pilots? We want a clear evaluation timeline (tech validation, accuracy gates, cost estimates) and an owners matrix so we can get internal alignment before our procurement review.

We are hoping to kick off the pilot the week of June 7 if that fits your capacity. Also, procurement will want a simple SOW and timeline — happy to loop them once we have a draft MAP.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of ML Products | Quantis
lena.ortiz@quantis.ai
attachments: Quantis-Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantis.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantis pilot: initial info and MAP request

Hi Lena — thanks for the sheet and the clear goals. Sharing our MAP canvas now and a short proposed timeline below. I also shared a GDoc (redwood-map-canvas-template.gdoc) with edit access for you and your stakeholders.

Quick MAP components we recommend (short):
- Objectives & success metrics (1 line each)
- Stakeholder roster & owners (tech, product, procurement)
- Week-by-week milestones (week0 tech setup -> week8 acceptance)
- Acceptance criteria & test prompts
- Rollout/fallback plan & cost estimates

Proposed condensed timeline for a pilot starting week of June 7:
- Week0 (June 7): infra access, sample data ingest, baseline smoke test
- Week1-2: model validation with initial prompts / latency checks
- Week3-4: quality gating + iteration with quantization/batching profiles
- Week5-6: integration tests and pre-acceptance checklist
- Week7-8: acceptance run, simple SOW + procurement handoff

Can we do a 30-min sync next Tue (May 25) to walk through the MAP and confirm owners? I can put a calendar invite; suggested times: 9:00am or 11:30am PT.

Sharing: redwood-map-canvas-template.gdoc (Google Doc, view/comment/edit)
Attachments: none (doc shared link above)

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com
redwood.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantis.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantis pilot: initial info and MAP request

On Wed, May 20, 2026 at 3:08 PM Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com> wrote:
> Can we do a 30-min sync next Tue (May 25) to walk through the MAP and confirm owners? I can put a calendar invite; suggested times: 9:00am or 11:30am PT.

Thanks Hiro — both times work for me. I made two quick edits to the template (comments in the GDoc):
- Add a short data classification row (PII/Sensitive) under Week0 so Quantis can confirm redaction needs.
- Add a cost estimate row per milestone (approx token costs + infra) — we typically use three bands: dev, pilot, prod.

Marissa, looping you in for procurement headings and a brief SOW skeleton. Can you stub a one-paragraph SOW after our sync that procurement can hand to their legal team?

Lena — I left suggested owners next to each milestone in the doc. If you want us to own more of the infra work, we can do that under Dedicated/Managed modes — we'll call that out in the SOW.

cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
attachments: none

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantis.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantis pilot: initial info and MAP request — draft shared

Thanks — I pushed an initial draft into the shared GDoc: quantis-initial-map-draft.gdoc. Key callouts in the draft:
- Week0 checklist (credentials, sample payloads, test account)
- Acceptance criteria: 3 metrics (accuracy on eval set, median latency @95th pct, false-positive rate)
- Owners: Quantis (data/labeling), Redwood (serving, infra), joint (evaluations)
- Risk triggers & fallback: we include a fallback to a smaller model + caching profile if latency targets fail

Attachments (for your review):
- quantis-initial-map-draft.gdoc (Google Doc - draft)
- quantis-week0-slides.pptx (slide deck stub for kick-off)

Asks:
- Lena: please review the acceptance metrics and confirm the eval set sampling approach by Tue May 26 EOD PT.
- Marissa: can you draft a one-paragraph SOW we can hand off to procurement after the sync?
- Jasmine: if you can quick-run the cost bands and add inline comments, I will finalize after your pass.

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue May 25 at 9:00am PT (30 min).

Best,
Hiro
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@quantis.ai>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Quantis procurement <procurement@quantis.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantis pilot: initial info and MAP request — draft shared

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the 9:00am PT slot on Tue May 25 worked well. I reviewed the draft and left a couple notes in the doc: primarily around eval sampling (we'll hand over a 2k-sample set, stratified by class) and data retention (we prefer 90-day logs). Procurement will prepare an initial SOW template and I copied them in here.

Next steps for us: procurement will send SOW stub by Fri May 29; we'll confirm owners in the doc by Tue Jun 1.

Looking forward to the pilot,
Lena
